ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: Clock input; provides clock to module (sampled by processes)
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple processes (en_shift_reg, synchronizer)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: Reset input, active-low (resets internal state)
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... reset assignments in processes

ports.name: en_i
ports.function: Enable-chain input (shifts into sreg, gates oscillator latches)
ports.evidence: sreg <= sreg(...) & en_i; latch gated when (en_i = '0')

ports.name: en_o
ports.function: Enable-chain output (drives next cell enable)

ports.name: rnd_o
ports.function: Random bit output (drives synchronized entropy bit)

signals.name: enable
signals.function: TRNG enable control register bit
signals.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); sample_en <= enable_i in sampling_control

signals.name: fifo_clr
signals.function: host-requested FIFO clear (auto-cleared)
signals.evidence: fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c); default fifo_clr <= '0' in bus_access

signals.name: fifo
signals.function: record grouping FIFO control and status signals
signals.evidence: type fifo_t record contains we,re,clear,wdata,rdata,avail,half,free

signals.name: fifo.we
signals.function: write-enable from neoTRNG valid output
signals.evidence: neoTRNG port map: valid_o => fifo.we (writes random bytes into FIFO)

signals.name: fifo.re
signals.function: read-enable for FIFO on bus read
signals.evidence: fifo.re <= '1' when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='0' and bus_req_i.addr(2)='1' else '0'

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.function: synchronous FIFO reset when disabled or cleared
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0' ; mapped to clear_i

signals.name: fifo.wdata
signals.function: random data byte produced by neoTRNG
signals.evidence: neoTRNG port map: data_o => fifo.wdata; mapped to FIFO wdata_i

signals.name: fifo.rdata
signals.function: random data byte read from FIFO
signals.evidence: bus_access: bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= fifo.rdata when fifo.avail = '1' (read path)

signals.name: fifo.avail
signals.function: indicates data available in FIFO
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl_avail_c <= fifo.avail and uses fifo.avail to select returned data

signals.name: fifo.half
signals.function: indicates FIFO at least half full
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map: half_o => fifo.half (status output)

signals.name: fifo.free
signals.function: indicates FIFO has free space
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map: free_o => fifo.free (status output)

signals.name: cell_en_in
signals.function: enable-chain inputs for each entropy cell
signals.evidence: cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en; cell_en_in(N-1 downto 1) <= cell_en_out(...)

signals.name: cell_en_out
signals.function: enable-chain outputs from each entropy cell
signals.evidence: Mapped to neoTRNG_cell en_o; used to form cell_en_in and debias_state

signals.name: cell_rnd
signals.function: per-cell sampled random bit outputs
signals.evidence: Connected to neoTRNG_cell rnd_o; XORed in combine process (for i loop)

signals.name: cell_sum
signals.function: XOR-combined bit of all cell outputs
signals.evidence: Combine process: tmp_v := tmp_v xor cell_rnd(i); cell_sum <= tmp_v

signals.name: debias_sreg
signals.function: two-bit buffer holding recent combined bits
signals.evidence: Clocked: debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum

signals.name: debias_state
signals.function: toggles to run de-bias every second cycle
signals.evidence: Clocked: debias_state <= (not debias_state) and cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left)

signals.name: debias_valid
signals.function: indicates a valid de-biased edge-derived bit
signals.evidence: debias_valid <= debias_state and (debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0))

signals.name: debias_data
signals.function: de-biased result bit (edge sample)
signals.evidence: debias_data <= debias_sreg(0) (used in sampling shift-register update)

signals.name: sample_en
signals.function: latched global sampling enable
signals.evidence: Clocked: sample_en <= enable_i (in sampling_control process)

signals.name: sample_sreg
signals.function: LFSR-style shift register assembling output byte
signals.evidence: Clocked: sample_sreg <= sample_sreg(6 downto 0) & (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data)

signals.name: sample_cnt
signals.function: counts de-biased bits collected for a sample
signals.evidence: Clocked: sample_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(sample_cnt) + 1); valid_o uses MSB

signals.name: sreg
signals.function: shift-register propagating enable input through inverter chain
signals.evidence: sreg <= sreg(sreg'left-1 downto 0) & en_i; en_o <= sreg(sreg'left)

signals.name: latch
signals.function: latches ring-oscillator nodes; holds or forwards inverter outputs
signals.evidence: latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i='0') else latch(i) when (sreg(i)='0') else inv_out(i)

signals.name: inv_in
signals.function: routes previous latch outputs into inverter inputs (ring chain)
signals.evidence: inv_in(0) <= latch(NUM_INV-1); inv_in(NUM_INV-1 downto 1) <= latch(NUM_INV-2 downto 0)

signals.name: inv_out
signals.function: inverter outputs of ring oscillator (not inv_in)
signals.evidence: inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i); (sim mode uses FF assigning inv_out)

signals.name: sync
signals.function: two-stage synchronizer sampling latch output into clock domain
signals.evidence: sync <= sync(0) & latch(latch'left); rnd_o <= sync(1)
